description: Address review findings: (1) audit log gap on first status assignment in postgres.go, (2) UI error handling in sbom-scan-detail.component.ts, (3) filter validation in HandleListFindingStatuses handler.
steps: Fix UpsertFindingStatus in postgres.go to create an audit log entry with old_status='open' when no prior record exists (first status assignment).
Fix confirmStatusChange in sbom-scan-detail.component.ts to add error handling to the subscribe call, showing feedback on failure and only clearing state on success.
Fix HandleListFindingStatuses in handlers.go to validate each status filter value against the allowed set and return 400 for invalid values.
Update the mock store UpsertFindingStatus to also create audit log entry on first status assignment (with old_status='open').
Add a test for invalid filter values in handlers_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: UpsertFindingStatus creates an audit log entry with old_status='open' when inserting a new finding status for the first time
The Angular component handles errors from the status update HTTP call and shows user feedback
HandleListFindingStatuses returns 400 for invalid status filter values
All existing tests continue to pass
New test for invalid filter values passes
findings: All three review issues addressed. Build passes, all 31 tests pass including new TestHandleListFindingStatuses_InvalidFilterValue and TestMockSBOMStore_FirstStatusAssignmentAuditLog tests. The audit log on first assignment only triggers when the initial status differs from the implicit 'open' default.
